chunks: He would have stayed in its belly till the day the dead are raised.
ai.seo_question: Who stayed in the belly of the whale until the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the unique status of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), emphasizing that his prolonged stay in the whale's belly was a period of intense spiritual purification and contemplation rather than mere physical confinement. Scholars highlight this as a paradigm of *sabr* (patience) and *tawhid* (monotheism) in isolation, illustrating how divine mercy preserves the faithful even in the depths of trial until the final resurrection.
